paragraphs.text: Sorine Daabson , better known as Sorine Relicbane , was a man from Soldev at the time of the Ice Age of Dominaria .
Sorine Relicsbane was a large, serious-looking bear of a man with a brownish beard. He was considered a heretic by his opponents.

Originally a rising young machinist, brilliant and talented, Sorine grew to become an outspoken opponent of the research of ancient artifacts by Arcum Dagsson and his machinists. He voiced the opinion that Arcum was attempting to create a mechanical utopia without paying attention to the lessons the Brothers' War which caused the Ice Age. Sorine's fears came true when the excavated Phyrexian war beasts and Arcum's Soldevi Steam Beasts went out of control due to the meddling of the Soldevi Adnates.
